messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: [P0] Prefill OOM + container restart spikes on gpu-pool-3 (multiple pods). Automatic shed started. Affected customers: 2x high-throughput tenants. Collecting traces, paging oncall.
Tom (oncall): on it, pulling traces now. any obvious node IDs?
Raj (runtime): seeing repeated OOMs at prefill for long-context requests (~>160k tokens). Node list from probe: gpu-node-54, gpu-node-58 showing restarts. Logs: `cudaErrorIllegalAddress` right before container restart.
Maya (sre): taking lead for mitigation. Priority: stop customer-facing retries, enable fallback to smaller-context model variant, cordon noisy nodes.
Ellie (support): flagged both customers and opened INC-9876, leaving a short note: "experiencing intermittent streaming disconnects, investigating" :warning:
Jun (eng-ops): running quarantine commands now: ```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-54
kubectl drain gpu-node-58 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=30
```
Tom (oncall): ack. Rolling a temporary routing change to avoid gpu-pool-3 for tenant A. Pushing `route: prefer: gpu-pool-1` via runtime config.
Raj (runtime): quick patch deployed: prefix/KV cache trimming enabled and reduced prefetch window to 4k tokens for fallback queues. Patch id: rte-2026-03-18-14.
incidents-bot: Deploy `rte-2026-03-18-14` succeeded in canary (2/2). Automatic fallback rules active.
Maya (sre): Observing reduction in immediate restarts, but one node still flapping. Plan: keep nodes cordoned, let autoscaler replace, follow-up with kernel and driver logs.
Ellie (support): Customer A updated: "We see reduced disconnects, but intermittent delays persist. Thanks for the quick work." Customer B on a PST shift, leaving a note for follow-up.
Raj (runtime): pulled GPU kernel trace (excerpt): ```
[2026-03-18T14:03:12Z] prefill_alloc: tried alloc 7.8G -> cudaErrorIllegalAddress
[2026-03-18T14:03:12Z] prefill: spilling to disk (coldmodel swap) failed: ENOSPC
[2026-03-18T14:03:13Z] container restart triggered by OOM killer
```
Tom (oncall): temporary mitigation checklist completed. Handoff to Raj for deep-dive (hardware/driver triage). I'm removing myself from pager in 10m if stable.
Raj (runtime): will own root-cause and post detailed RCA. Immediate next steps: collect core dumps from gpu-node-54, compare driver versions across pool, run `nvidia-smi -q` snapshots, and re-run prefill stress harness.
Maya (sre): Note for postmortem: consider adding a soft-prefill token quota per-tenant and circuit-breaker for prefill path to avoid cross-tenant noisy long-context storms.
Jun (eng-ops): created infra ticket INFRA-4521 to schedule node replacement and driver upgrade. ETA for replacement: 4h.
incidents-bot: Incident assigned: INC-9876. Priority: P0 -> initial severity: customer-impacting degraded streaming.
Tom (oncall): marking thread as bridge-closed from oncall POV; leaving it open for postmortem work. :thumbsup:
